events.body:
Summary
In the empty-state cards on the Leaderboard page ("Top Reporters", "Top Commenters", "Top Domains"), the placeholder icons (Trophy, Speech Bubble, Globe) are improperly aligned.

Observed Behavior
- The icons are pinned tightly against the far-left padding/border of each card container.
- They lack vertical centering and proper proportional spacing relative to the adjacent placeholder text, causing the card interior to look unbalanced and broken.

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 011237.png](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
events.title: [UI] Empty-state icons in Leaderboard cards are misaligned and pushed against the left border
